title: 3.2.28 Lab: Sum 1 to N
description: Define sumToN(n) that uses a for loop to add every integer from 1 to n and returns the total. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Define sumToN
steps.instructions: Define a function called sumToN that takes one parameter, n. Inside the function, create a variable to hold the running total, starting at 0.

steps.title: Add a for loop
steps.instructions: Write a for loop inside sumToN that counts from 1 up to and including n. On each iteration, add the current counter value to your running total.

steps.title: Return the total
steps.instructions: After the loop ends, return the running total. Then call sumToN with a few different values and log the results to verify. Expected: sumToN(5) is 15, sumToN(10) is 55, and sumToN(100) is 5050.
